value.rationale: A mathematically natural interpolation between one-sided exponential critical frames and the nonframe continuous two-sided exponential is completely classified, revealing a full closed region of discontinuous nonframes, exact optimal frame bounds, two sharp quadratic boundaries, full frame-operator spectrum, and a universal conditioning barrier for positive bilateral tails. These are quantitatively meaningful boundary/structure facts and exceed routine substitution of a known fixed-window estimate.
